entities.summary: Logan Shaw is a Canadian professional ice hockey right winger and captain for the Toronto Marlies in the American Hockey League (AHL). He was drafted 76th overall by the Florida Panthers in the 2011 NHL entry draft. He also previously played for the Anaheim Ducks, Montreal Canadiens, Winnipeg Jets, and Ottawa Senators.
